name: AnythingButLaw
tagline_zh: 律师只懂法？谈判桌上被对手用商业逻辑碾压？这套技能把博弈论、会计、统计炼成可用的法外功夫，附公式与对抗清单。
tagline_en: Lawyers, tired of losing deals to business logic? Master game theory, accounting & stats with formulas, examples.
desc_en: 法外功夫 — Non-legal business skills for lawyers. Decision analysis, game theory, contract design, accounting, finance, microeconomics, law & economics, statistics, and regression analysis distilled into deep, actionable frameworks for legal practice. Each domain includes formulas with LaTeX notation, worked examples, adversarial checklists, and book-aligned structure. | 律师必备的非法律商业技能深度参考：决策分析、博弈论、合同设计
why_zh: 同类技能多止于概念，它却给全公式、算例和对抗清单，直接嵌入法律实务，像随身军师。
